title: Cannot generate the initializer of a member.
rationale: The message and the title use the contraction 'Couldn't', which the Metalama message style forbids, and 'get initializer' is imprecise: the report site (AdviceSyntaxGenerator.GetInitializerExpressionOrMethod) reports it when generating the syntax of the InitializerExpression of an introduced field, property or event throws. The message keeps no final period because {1} is the exception message, which normally ends with one.
